<details>
<summary>Project notes &amp; engineering background</summary>

- **[SLClean](https://github.com/SalyyS1/SLClean)** — a Windows disk utility with review-before-delete controls; downloadable releases.
- **[SLTerm](https://github.com/SalyyS1/SLTerm)** — a customized workspace based on [Wave Terminal](https://github.com/wavetermdev/waveterm); upstream credit matters.
- **[DiscordsRPC](https://github.com/SalyyS1/DiscordsRPC)** — a personal desktop integration project for Discord and Spotify.
- **[Foliora](https://github.com/SalyyS1/foliora)** — an experimental context-pack application, with source-backed review and optional AI assistance. Its prerelease and release checklist describe current limits.
- **[SylaBot](https://github.com/SalyyS1/discord-bot)** — a personal bot/dashboard project; ongoing engineering work, not a production-readiness claim.

I also build in the Minecraft ecosystem. [minecraftkit](https://github.com/SalyyS1/minecraftkit) explores agent skills and API knowledge; [foliascan](https://github.com/SalyyS1/foliascan) explores bytecode analysis; [mcstage](https://github.com/SalyyS1/mcstage) explores integration tests against real servers.

</details>

<details>
<summary>About this profile</summary>

Original “Personal Software Lab” visual system. SVGs generated locally from GitHub data and refreshed by GitHub Actions. No external image service required. Calendar counts follow GitHub’s contribution calendar; repository metadata is public only.

Edit `profile.config.json`, then run `npm ci`, `npm run refresh` and `npm run check` with Node.js 22+ and an authenticated GitHub CLI. `npm run render` reuses the saved snapshot offline.

[Geist](https://github.com/vercel/geist-font) fonts use the [SIL Open Font License](design/fonts/OFL-Geist.txt). The SVG/Actions approach was inspired by [keepmeside](https://github.com/keepmeside); the artwork, layout and renderer here are original.

</details>
